- {mi} — "I, me"
- {do} — "you"

#### Verbs have numbered places
A verb (*selbri*) has numbered places:
- {tavla} — "x1 talks to x2 about x3"
- **mi tavla do** — "I talk to you"

#### Nouns
- {le} turns a word into a noun: **le prenu** "the person", **le pendo** "the friend"
- {cu} separates the subject from the verb: *le prenu **cu** tavla mi*

#### Yes and no
- {na} negates: **mi na smujmi** "I don't understand"
- {je'u} — "truly, yes"

items.free_content_front: How to greet, say goodbye and ask simple questions
items.free_content_back:
#### Greetings
- {coi} — "hello"
- {co'o} — "goodbye"
- {doi} calls someone: **doi la .alis.** "Hey, Alice!"
- {ro} — "every, all": **coi ro do** "hello, all of you"

#### Names
- {la} marks a name: **la .djan.**
- Names start and end with a pause (the dots).

#### Questions
1. {xu} makes a yes/no question: **xu do smujmi** "Do you understand?"
2. {ma} asks "what/who?" in the place you want filled: **do zukte ma** "What are you doing?"

#### Feelings
- {ui} expresses happiness: "Yay!"

items.free_content_front: Polite requests and linking extra places to nouns
items.free_content_back:
#### Polite words
Attitudinals go at the start of a sentence:
- {e'o} — request, "please"
- {e'u} — suggestion, "I suggest"
- {ki'e} — "thanks"

#### In a language
- {bau} — "in the language": **bau la .lojban.** "in Lojban"

#### Adding places to nouns with {be}
- **le tavla be mi** — "those who talk to me"
- **le saske be le logji** — "the science of logic"
- {be fi} fills the third place: **le smujmi be fi mi** "those who understand me"

#### Events
- {le nu} — "the event that…": **mi djica le nu do pendo mi** "I want you to be my friend"

items.free_content_front: Whole sentences inside sentences, and joining sentences
items.free_content_back:
#### Events with {nu}
{nu} makes an *event* out of a sentence. This is how Lojban says "to do / that…":
- **le nu mi tadni** — "(the event) that I study"
- **mi djica le nu mi tavla do** — "I want to talk to you"
- {gleki} "x1 is happy about x2": **mi gleki le nu …** "I'm happy that …"

#### Joining sentences
- {.i} separates two sentences: **mi tavla do .i mi smujmi fi do**

#### Duration
- {ze'a} — "during (an interval)": **ze'a le cacra be li ze** "for seven hours"

items.free_content_front: Saying your name and quoting words
items.free_content_back:
#### Quoting
- {zo} quotes exactly one word: **zo coi** "the word *coi*"
- {lu} … {li'u} quotes a longer Lojban text: **lu coi do li'u**
- {cusku} "x1 says x2": **mi cusku zo coi**

#### Names
- {cmene} "x1 is the name of x2": **zo .djan. cmene mi** "John is my name"
- {me} turns a name into a verb: **mi me la .djan.** "I am John"

items.free_content_front: Lojban tense is optional; add it only when you need it
items.free_content_back:
#### Tense words
Place them before the verb:
- {pu} — before (past)
- {ca} — at the same time (present)
- {ba} — after (future)

#### Examples
- **mi pu tavla** — "I talked"
- **mi ba tavla** — "I will talk"

#### With negation
- They combine with {na}: **mi na pu tavla la .mark.** "I didn't talk to Mark"

#### New verb
- {penmi} — "x1 meets x2"

#### Place labels
Every verb has numbered places. These label the next noun:
1. {fa} — place one
2. {fe} — place two
3. {fi} — place three
4. {fo} — place four
5. {fu} — place five

#### Reordering freely
- **mi dunda ti do** = **mi dunda fi do fe ti** — "I give this to you"
- **fe zo coi pu cusku fa mi** — "*Hello*, said I."

#### Words
- {dunda} — "x1 gives x2 to x3"
- {ti} — "this (near me)"

items.free_content_front: Two verbs side by side form a tanru: the first word modifies the last
items.free_content_back:
#### Examples
- **mutce tatpi** — "very tired"
- **sutra tavla** — "talk fast"

#### Useful modifiers
- {mutce} — "much, very"
- {melbi} — "beautiful"
- {cizra} — "strange"
- {cinri} — "interesting"
- {nandu} — "difficult"
- {zabna} — "nice, cool"

#### Events as subjects
- **le nu tadni la .lojban. cu mutce cinri** — "Studying Lojban is very interesting"

items.free_content_front: Talking about this app and your studies
items.free_content_back:
#### Using things
- {pilno} — "x1 uses x2 for purpose x3"
- **mi pilno la lensisku le nu mi tadni** — "I use lensisku to study"

#### Words
- {xamgu} — "x1 is good for x2"
- {tatpi} — "x1 is tired of x2"
- {surla} — "x1 relaxes, rests"

#### Lojbanic
- {lojbo} — "Lojbanic", used in tanru: **le lojbo jufra** "the Lojban sentences"

#### Properties with {ka}
{ka} makes a *property* (an ability or quality) instead of an event. Its subject is left open:
- **le ka tavla do** — "talking to you"

#### Verbs that take a property
- {kakne} "x1 is able to do x2": **mi kakne le ka tavla do** "I can talk to you"
- {troci} "x1 tries to do x2": **mi troci le ka tavla bau la .lojban.**

#### Words
- {frili} — "easy"
- {vlaste} — "dictionary"

items.free_content_front: Everyday phrases for knowing, thinking and planning
items.free_content_back:
#### Statements with {du'u}
{du'u} makes a *statement* (a fact you know or think):
- **mi djuno le du'u …** — "I know that …"
- **mi jinvi le du'u …** — "I think that …"

#### Attitudes
- {ku'i} — "but"
- {ei} — "I should"
- {ai} — "I intend to": **.ai mi citka** "I'm going to eat"

#### Seeming and possibility
- {simlu} "x1 seems to have property x2": **simlu le ka zabna** "seems cool"
- {cumki} "possible": **cumki fa le nu mi srera** "maybe I'm wrong"

#### Also
- **ca le cabdei** — "today"
- {smuni} — "x1 is the meaning of x2"
- {zoi} quotes non-Lojban text

items.free_content_front: Beginnings, the recent past and causes
items.free_content_back:
#### Starting
- {co'a} — "start to": **mi co'a smujmi** "I'm beginning to understand"

#### The recent past
- {zi} — "a short time"
- **mi pu zi citka** — "I just ate"
- **pu zi co'a cikna** — "just woke up"

#### Causes
- {rinka} "x1 causes x2": **le nu mi tadni … cu rinka le nu mi smujmi …**

items.free_content_front: Who? What? Why? How long? — and counting
items.free_content_back:
#### Questions
- {ma} fills a place with a question: **ma cmene do** "What is your name?"
- {ki'u ma} — "why (for what reason)?"
- {ze'a ma} — "for how long?"

#### Digits

- **0** {no} · **1** {pa} · **2** {re} · **3** {ci} · **4** {vo}
- **5** {mu} · **6** {xa} · **7** {ze} · **8** {bi} · **9** {so}

Strings of digits form numbers: **pa no** = 10, **re no** = 20.

#### Using numbers
- {li} introduces a number: **le djedi be li re** "two days"
- A number before a noun counts it: **no le prenu** "none of the people"
- Time words: {masti} month, {cacra} hour, {mentu} minute, {nanca} year

#### Languages
- {se bangu} — "x1 speaks language x2" ({se} swaps the first two places of {bangu})
- **xu do se bangu le glico** — "Do you speak English?"

#### Answering
- {go'i} repeats the previous statement: "yes"
- **na go'i** — "no"

#### Words
- {milxe} — "mildly, a little"
- {merko} — "American"

#### How are you?
- {mo} asks "what is it / what's the state?": **do mo** "How are you?"

#### Good and not good
- {zabna} — "good, nice"; **zabna se bangu** "speak well"
- {na'e} — "other than, not-": **na'e zabna** "not well"

#### Words
- {tcima} — "weather"
- {vi} — "here, at": **vi mi** "at my place"
- {cliva} — "x1 leaves"; **co'o do** "goodbye"

#### Weather
- {carvi} — "it rains"; **ca carvi** "it's raining now"
- {glare} — "hot"

#### Likes
- {nelci} — "x1 likes x2"
- **mi na nelci le nu glare** — "I don't like it when it's hot"

#### Little words
- {ji'a} — "also": **… vi mi ji'a** "at my place too"
- {ku'i} — "but"
- **co'o cliva** — a goodbye to someone leaving

#### Where?
- {zvati} — "x1 is at x2": **la gleki cu zvati ma** "Where is Happy?"
- {klama} — "x1 goes to x2"

#### Places
- {panka} — "park"
- {zdani} — "home"
- {jibni} — "x1 is near x2"
- {darno} — "x1 is far from x2"

#### Introducing yourself
- {mi'e} — "I am…": **mi'e la rozgu**

#### Joining nouns
- {.e} — "and" between nouns
- {vau} closes a sentence part before {.e}

#### Attitudes
- {au} — "I wish, want"
- {pei} turns an attitudinal into a question: **.au pei** "do you want…?"
- {ai} — "I intend"; {ainai} — "I won't" (refusal)
- {nai} negates the attitudinal

#### Translating
- {fanva} — "x1 translates x2 into language x3 from x4 with result x5"
- **fanva … la .lojban. fu ma** — "what is it in Lojban?" ({fu} asks for the resulting text)

#### Words
- {ba zi} — "soon"
- {citka} — "eat", {pinxe} — "drink", {stasu} — "soup"

#### Articles
- {lo} — "some, a" (non-specific): **lo jisra** "some juice", **lo djacu** "some water"
- {lo'e} — "the typical, in general": **mi nelci lo'e jisra** "I like juice (in general)"

#### Both … and
- {ge} … {gi}: **ge do gi mi** "both you and I"

#### Time
- {za} — "some time from now"
- **ca ma** — "when?"
- **ca le vanci** — "in the evening"

#### Also
- {je'e} — "got it, roger"

#### Not wanting
- {aunai} — "I don't want to"
- **ba za go'i** — "will do it later"

#### Where?
- {bu'u} — "at (place), coinciding with": **bu'u ma** "where?" ([CLL 10.2](https://lojban.org/publications/cll/cll_v1.1_xhtml-section-chunks/section-spatial-tenses.html))

#### Going out
- {gusta} — "restaurant"
- **.ai mi klama lo gusta** — "I'm going to a restaurant"

#### Buying and selling
- {vecnu} — "x1 sells x2 to x3"
- {te} swaps places one and three, so **te vecnu** = "buy"
- **mi te vecnu su'o da** — "I'll buy something"
- {su'o da} — "at least one thing, something"

#### Which one?
- {ji} — "or?" between nouns: **lo jisra ji lo djacu** "juice or water?"
- {je'i} does this between verbs ([CLL 14.13](https://lojban.org/publications/cll/cll_v1.1_xhtml-section-chunks/section-truth-and-connective-questions.html))

#### Words
- {titnanba} — "cookie"
- {djica} — "x1 wants x2 (an event)"

#### Clock time
- {ti'u} — "at the time": **ti'u li cacra bu pa** "at one o'clock"
- {bu} makes a letter-word from the word before it ([CLL 17.4](https://lojban.org/publications/cll/cll_v1.1_xhtml-section-chunks/section-bu.html))

#### Topics
- {zo'u} separates a topic from the comment: **ra'a mi zo'u …** "as for me, …" ([CLL 19.4](https://lojban.org/publications/cll/cll_v1.1_xhtml-section-chunks/section-topic-comments.html))

#### Also
- {i'e} — approval
- **no da zvati ti** — "nobody is here"
- {botpi} — "bottle", {kargu} — "expensive"
- {lei} — "the mass of"

#### Greetings by time
- {cerni} — "morning": **cerni coi** "good morning"
- {vanci} — "evening": **vanci coi** "good evening"

#### What time is it?
- {tcika} — "x1 is the time of x2"
- **ma ca tcika** — "what time is it now?"

#### Indirect questions
- {kau} marks an indirect question: **mi na djuno le du'u xukau ti kukte** "I don't know whether this is tasty"

#### Also
- {ce'e} links extra terms in a list
- {kukte} — "tasty"

#### Suggesting
- {pei} asks for the listener's attitude ("how do you feel about it?")
- **pei do tavla mi** — "how about you talk to me?" ([CLL 13.10](https://lojban.org/publications/cll/cll_v1.1_xhtml-section-chunks/section-questions-empathy-contours.html))

#### Answering
- {i'a} — "I accept"
- {ie} — agreement, "yes"
- {u'u} — "sorry"
- {ja'o} — "therefore, so"

#### Setting the time
- **ti'u li cacra bu mu veti'u la .nuiork.** — "at five, New York time"

#### Words
- {kufra} — "x1 is comfortable, convenient for x2"
- {voksa} — "voice"

#### Days

- **ca le prulamdei** — "yesterday"
- **ca le cabdei** — "today"
- **ca le bavlamdei** — "tomorrow"

#### Talking it over
- {casnu} — "x1 discuss x2"
- {mi'o} — "you and I"
- {tu'a} — "something about…": **tu'a le bavlamdei cu zabna** "tomorrow is fine"

#### Asking about one word
- {xu} can go right before the word you're asking about: **ca le xu cabdei** "today?"
- {birti} — "sure"

#### Prices
- {meryru'u} — "x1 is worth x2 US dollars"
- **ti meryru'u li pa ci** — "it's 13 dollars"
- {ji'i} — "approximately"

#### Big numbers
- {gei} writes numbers with powers of ten: **bi gei ci** = 3×10⁸ ([CLL 18.14](https://lojban.org/publications/cll/cll_v1.1_xhtml-section-chunks/section-infix-again.html))

#### Words
- {ponse} — "x1 owns x2"
- {jdini} — "money"
- {karce} — "car"
- {loi} — "a mass of"

#### How many
- {so'o} — "several"
- {so'u} — "a few"

#### Too much, enough
- {du'enzu} — "too much": **do du'enzu sutra tavla** "you speak too fast"
- {raunzu} — "enough"

#### Words
- {masno} — "slow"
- {seva'u} — "for the benefit of": **seva'u do** "for you"
- {zarci} — "shop", {cidja} — "food"

#### Prices
- {jdima} — "x1 is the price of x2": **ma jdima** "what's the price?"
- {pi} is the decimal point: **li pa pi mu no** "1.50"

#### Comparing
- {semau} — "more than"
- **ti ne semau tu kargu** — "this is more expensive than that"
- {tolkargu} — "cheap" ({to'e} opposite + {kargu})

#### Words
- {speni} — "spouse"
- {ri} — "the previous one"
- {joi} — "together with"

#### Welcome
- {fi'i} — "welcome!"
- {ei} with {ma}: **mi'o casnu ma .ei** "what shall we discuss?"

#### Travelling
- {litru} — "x1 travels via route x2"
- {pu'i} — "can and has (ever) done" ([CLL 10.19](https://lojban.org/publications/cll/cll_v1.1_xhtml-section-chunks/section-caha.html)): **xu do pu'i litru …** "have you ever travelled …?"

#### Where you live
- {xabju} — "x1 lives in x2"
- {gugde} — "country", {tcadu} — "city"
- {ropno} — "Europe", {xazdo} — "Asia"

#### Drinks
- {vanju} — "wine", {djalitki} — "drink, beverage"

#### Getting attention
- {ju'i} — "attention! / hello?"
- {tirna} — "x1 hears x2"

#### Commands
- {ko} makes a command: **ko na xanka** "don't be nervous" ({xanka} "nervous")
- {je'a} — "indeed"

#### Children
- {se panzi} — "x1 has child x2": **mi se panzi re da** "I have two children"
- {nanla} — "boy", {nixli} — "girl"
- {tixnu} — "daughter", {bersa} — "son"

#### Hobbies
- {se cuntu} — "x1 is engaged in activity x2" ({cuntu} "x1 is an activity of x2")
- **mi se cuntu la .soker.**

#### Asking about age
- **xu le bersa be do cu makcu** — "Is your son grown-up?"
- {makcu} — "grown-up, mature"
- {cifnu} — "baby"

#### Whose?
- {bersa} — "son", {tixnu} — "daughter"
- The {be} construction names whose: **le tixnu be mi**

items.free_content_front: How many, where, and how far
items.free_content_back:
#### How many?
- {xo} asks for a number: **do se panzi xo da** "how many children do you have?"
- {ue} — "surprise!"

#### Distance
- {sepli} — "x1 is apart from x2, separated by x3"
- **… le ki'otre be li mu no** — "by 50 kilometers"
- {cmalu} — "small", {darno} — "far"

#### Also
- {dikca} — "electricity"
- {lo'e} — "typical"

#### Questions
- **do xabju ma** — "where do you live?"
- {go'i} answers "yes", repeating the question's statement

#### Words
- {lanzu} — "family"
- {barda} — "big"

#### Paying
- {pleji} — "x1 pays x2 to x3 for x4"
- **mi pleji tu'a le meryru'u … le kagni tu'a lo'e dikca**
- {kagni} — "company"

#### Regularly
- **ca ro detma'i** — "every calendar month"

#### Together
- {jo'u} — "and, together with" (non-logical): **mi jo'u le speni be mi**

items.free_content_front: Ending the day and talking about jobs
items.free_content_back:
#### Evening
- **ca vanci fi mi** — "it's evening for me"
- **te vanci** — "one who is in their evening"
- {lerci} — "late"

#### Sleep and work
- {sipna} — "sleep"
- {nitcu} — "x1 needs x2"
- {gunka} — "x1 works"

#### Jobs
- {jibri} — "x1 is a job of x2": **ma jibri do** "what is your job?"
- {finti} — "create, write"; {proga} — "program"

#### How long

- {ze'i} — "for a short time"
- {ze'a} — "for a medium time"
- {ze'u} — "for a long time"

#### Travelling
- {fu} fills the fifth place of {klama} (vehicle): **klama le tcadu fu tu'a le taksi** "go to the city by taxi"
- {pe} — "belonging to": **le karce pe mi** "my car"
- {vitke} — "x1 visits x2 at x3"; {stali} — "x1 stays"

#### Expectations and reasons
- {kanpe} — "x1 expects x2"; {la'a} — "probably"
- **.i ki'u bo** — "because": the next sentence gives the reason ([CLL 9.7](https://lojban.org/publications/cll/cll_v1.1_xhtml-section-chunks/section-causals.html))

#### Time words
- {jeftu} — "week"
- **ca le cabvanci** — "this evening"

items.free_content_front: Plans for a visit and coming back
items.free_content_back:
#### In the city
- {bu'u} — "at the place": **bu'u le tcadu** "in the city"

#### After the visit
- {kei} closes an abstraction: **ba le nu vitke kei** "after the visit"

#### Coming back
- {di'a} — "resume (start again after a pause)": **mi di'a klama ti** "I come back here" ([CLL 10.10](https://lojban.org/publications/cll/cll_v1.1_xhtml-section-chunks/section-event-contours.html))

#### A polite goodbye
- **lo ka tavla do kei pu pluka mi** — "It was a pleasure to talk to you"
- {pluka} — "x1 pleases x2"

#### Indirect questions
- {makau} asks indirectly: **mi na djuno le du'u ca makau …** "I don't know when …"

#### Reasons
- {ki'u} — "because": **… ki'u le nu le speni be mi cu nitcu su'o da**

#### Words
- {co'e} — "do the thing (unspecified)"
- {kansa} — "x1 accompanies x2 in x3"

items.free_content_front: A review of times of day and food
items.free_content_back:
#### Times of day
- **ca le cerni be le cabdei** — "this morning"
- **ca le vanci be le cabdei** — "this evening"

#### Food
- {kukte} — "tasty"
- {su'o} — "at least one, some"

#### Agreeing
- {ie} — "yes, agreed": **mi nelci .i ie mi nelci**
